feed.title: We made the bitcoin-dev mailing list readable: 15 years, 24,699 messages

entry.title: We made the bitcoin-dev mailing list readable: 15 years, 24,699 messages
entry.summary:
The Linux Foundation's archive for a particular mailing list was recently removed, nearly resulting in the loss of its historical content. Unlike the bitcoin-dev mailing list, which was widely mirrored and preserved by various parties, this list did not benefit from such widespread backup efforts. Fortunately, the messages have been partially preserved through the Wayback Machine, which managed to capture monthly files from May to December of 2017. This period comprises just under 700 messages.
Given the manageable size of this archive and its compatibility with the same format used by lightning-dev, there are considerations underway to add it as a distinct mailing list. This approach would facilitate easier access and reference for those interested in the archived discussions and ensure that valuable historical context is not lost to the broader development community.
